points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight layouts passed examiner validator, but two force-unstable cases are labeled converged.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior explicit validator passed eight final directories and report; structural scope, not physical acceptance.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M015 and M080 laminar statuses claim stable convergence despite material final-window force variation; DQ7. Re200 completed t300 and has actual periodic force history.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd0.889 is far below reference ~2, Re200 mean Cd0.995 is low, and M080 lift drifts; M200 lam stable with disclosed flux sensitivity.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted 37-page contestant PDF contains case force/residual, surface and zoomed field plots; Re200 separate late lift and drag clearly visible.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Useful disclosures of slow convergence and low-Mach drag, but M015 8000-step continuation band and M080 <1% drag/stable lift claims conflict with histories; rank spread understated.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Original commit97128af tracks all eight force/residual/status/metadata files matching workspace. Re20 force, residual and Mach-zoom images reproduce pixel-identically; exact historical executable hash binding unproven.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
